name: Weekly stock and cash reorder watcher
why: The weekly watch list in agent form: what to reorder, what it costs and whether cash covers it.

name: Reorder stock before you run out and track the shipment
why: End-to-end reorder flow from reorder point to purchase order to tracking the shipment.

name: Set your order size and split it across suppliers
why: Order sizing with minimums and a split between a cheap slow supplier and a fast dear one.

name: Plan the cash for your next stock order
why: Turns a buy list into cash by week, deposits included, against the owner's floor.

name: Inventory cash planner
why: Order dates, cash needed, the lowest cash point and a downside case from lead time and unit cost.

name: Supplier quote comparer
why: Puts price, minimum order, lead time and deposit risk side by side before a new supplier is chosen.

name: Supplier quote request writer
why: Drafts a request for quotation in maker terms when a backup supplier is needed.

name: Supplier terms and float planner
why: Works out the cash float from payment terms and lead time, and which terms to ask for.

name: Product bill of materials builder
why: Builds a costed bill of materials by part, the base for unit cost and material planning.

name: Check capacity before promising a delivery date
why: Capacity view and date options with risks before a maker promises a delivery.

name: Amazon inbound stock planner
why: Sizes and times stock sent to Amazon, where inbound lead time adds to supplier lead time.

name: Explain a warehouse stock count variance
why: Separates timing, unit and count errors when stock on hand does not match the system.

name: Prepare a supplier corrective action review
why: Checks a supplier's reply to a quality failure against goods-in evidence before a claim.
